class.name: DisPdu
class.brief_description: Static helpers to inspect, decode and validate DIS PDUs and to convert DIS timestamps.

method.name: decode
method.description: Decodes [param bytes] into the [DisPduBase] subclass selected by the PDU type byte (byte 2 of the header), for example a [DisEntityStatePdu] or a [DisFirePdu]. The supported types are the [enum PduType] values other than [constant PDU_TYPE_OTHER]; see [method is_supported]. Returns [code]null[/code] and sets [method get_last_error] if [param bytes] is shorter than 12 bytes, the type is not supported, or the type's own decoder rejects the packet (unknown protocol version, length field larger than the data, body too short or inconsistent).

method.name: get_effective_length
method.description: Returns the length of the PDU in [param bytes]: the header length field (bytes 8-9), or [code]bytes.size()[/code] if that field is 0 (some senders never fill it in) or if [param bytes] is shorter than a header. This does not validate anything; the value can be larger than [code]bytes.size()[/code] for a truncated packet.

method.name: get_last_error
method.description: Returns the reason the last failed decode on the calling thread was rejected, such as [code]"unsupported PDU type 99"[/code]. The message is kept per thread, so a receive thread and the main thread do not overwrite each other. It is set to an empty string when a later decode gets through header validation.

method.name: is_supported
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [method decode] can decode [param pdu_type], one of the [enum PduType] values except [constant PDU_TYPE_OTHER].

method.name: peek_header
method.description: Reads the 12-byte PDU header of [param bytes] without decoding the body. Returns an empty [Dictionary] if [param bytes] is shorter than 12 bytes. Otherwise the keys are [code]protocol_version[/code], [code]exercise_id[/code], [code]pdu_type[/code], [code]protocol_family[/code], [code]timestamp[/code] (raw unsigned 32-bit value, see [method timestamp_to_seconds]), [code]length[/code] (the raw length field, which may be 0) and [code]pdu_status[/code], all as [int]. The values are not validated; check [code]pdu_type[/code] with [method is_supported] before decoding.

method.name: timestamp_from_seconds
method.description: Converts [param seconds_past_hour] to a DIS timestamp as used in the PDU header. A DIS timestamp counts 2^31 units per hour, shifted left by one bit; the lowest bit is set for absolute time ([param absolute] = [code]true[/code], the sender's clock is synchronised to UTC) and clear for relative time. [param seconds_past_hour] is wrapped into the range 0 to 3600 first, so negative values and values above one hour are accepted. Assign the result to [member DisPduBase.timestamp].

method.name: timestamp_is_absolute
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the lowest bit of [param timestamp] is set, meaning it is absolute (UTC-synchronised) time rather than relative time.

method.name: timestamp_to_seconds
method.description: Converts a DIS [param timestamp] to seconds past the hour (0 to 3600), ignoring the absolute/relative bit. Only the lower 32 bits of [param timestamp] are used.

constants.constant: PDU type 0, "Other". Not decodable; [method is_supported] returns [code]false[/code].
Entity State PDU ([DisEntityStatePdu]), protocol family 1 (Entity Information).
Create Entity PDU ([DisCreateEntityPdu]), protocol family 5 (Simulation Management).
Remove Entity PDU ([DisRemoveEntityPdu]), protocol family 5 (Simulation Management).
Set Data PDU ([DisSetDataPdu]), protocol family 5 (Simulation Management).
